name: io.github.st412m/brickproof-adb
title: brickproof-adb
description: Maintain your own Android devices and TV boxes over ADB with dry runs, guards and rollback

environmentVariables.name: BRICKPROOF_ADB
environmentVariables.description: Path of the adb executable; optional, default adb on PATH

environmentVariables.name: BRICKPROOF_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Host directories adb_push, adb_pull and adb_install may use, separated by ; on Windows and : elsewhere; optional

environmentVariables.name: BRICKPROOF_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSON config file; optional
